created.description: The match's created time, as in its upload: which match the track is for.

start.description: When the track starts (the first kickoff), in seconds since 1970.

count.description: How many chunks the track has.

data.description: The chunk's samples as the watch packs them, "dt,dlat,dlon,speed,hr;" each: tenths of a second since the sample before (empty for 10; the chunk's first counts from start), millionths of a degree moved since the chunk's position before (the first is whole; both empty without a new fix), the speed the watch measured in cm/s, and beats a minute. Empty fields mean unknown; trailing ones are left off.

description: Part of a match's track as the watch recorded it (TRK-7): GPS and heart rate about once a second during the periods.
